{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Rock-Hard Food Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Rock-Hard Food Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW, TotK |other= |pronunciation= |plural= |cost= |value= |location= |uses= Restoring a quarter of a [[Heart]] |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} '''Rock-Hard Food''' is a recurring [[Meal]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Rock-Hard Food|Rock-Hard Food|Series, BotW, TotK}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Rock-Hard Food is the result of an invalid [[Cooking]] [[Recipe]]. It appears when [[Link]] attempts to cook food containing [[Wood]] or Ores. Rock-Hard Food only restores a quarter of one of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s and has no effects. Eating these [[Meal]]s is noted to be difficult. [[Moza]], the aspiring chef who can be found near [[Ishto Soh Shrine]], has a recipe called the lavish [[Meat]] dish that will only result in Rock-Hard Food. She tells Link to prepare either bird Meat or steak and then to throw in some Ore. If Link calls the recipe gross, she scolds him for being rude and asks how else one is supposed to be a lavish Meat dish. However, Moza admits that the resulting Meal is always Rock-Hard Food, but she does not understand how it gets that rocky. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Dubious Food * Food * Meal }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Rock-Hard Food}}
